description: This PHP script functions as a client for the TestLink API, specifically calling the 'removePlatformFromTestPlan' method to remove a platform from a test plan. It sets up parameters such as devKey, testplanid, and platformname, and executes the API call using the IXR_Client class.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A client class used to communicate with the XML-RPC server in TestLink, instantiated to interact with the API.

methods.name: removePlatformFromTestPlan
methods.description: The API method name that removes a specified platform from a test plan.
